summary: Full health check across MASCI Safety Hub. Backend pytest 39/39 PASS (test_inspections.py + test_meetings_jhas.py + test_incidents.py) covering CRUD + 422 + 404 + _id-leak guards on /api/inspections, /api/meetings, /api/jhas, /api/incidents. Frontend probed live preview URL: Hub renders exactly 4 tiles (hub-tile-inspections|meetings|jha|incidents), 0 'Recent Activity' nodes, lang-en/lang-es present, company-info-btn present. EN h1 = 'One front door for every safety form.' ES h1 = 'Una puerta de entrada para cada formulario de seguridad.' (exact match to spec). Company Info dialog defaults verified field-by-field via DOM probe: ci-company-name='MASCI General Contractors Inc.', ci-address='5752 South Ridgewood Avenue', ci-csz='Port Orange, FL 32127-6442', ci-phone='386-322-4500', ci-email='safety@mascigc.com', ci-website='mascigc.com', ci-license=''. JobPicker on all 4 forms (/inspect/new, /meetings/new, /jha/new, /incidents/new) renders [data-testid=job-picker-trigger] and use-gps-btn. JobPicker A1A search → 1 result; selecting it auto-fills input-project-name='T5861 A1A - Jimmy Buffet Hwy' and input-project-number='25-23 - CP'. TopicPicker on /meetings/new: 'trench' search → 1 result; selecting trenching_shoring prefills input-topic='Trenching, Shoring & Excavation Safety' and input-hazards-reviewed (Cave-in / collapse · Engulfment …). When ES is active, the same picker prefills Spanish: 'Derrumbe / colapso · Sepultamiento · Caídas a la excavación …' confirming i18n topic library wiring. Bilingual consent: testids 'attendee-add' and 'bilingual-consent' present on /meetings/new. Public submit routes /inspections/submit, /meetings/submit, /jha/submit, /incidents/submit all render without auth, returning healthy h1 ('Job Site Safety Inspection', 'Site Safety Meeting', 'Job Hazard Analysis', 'Accident / Incident Report'). View page (/incidents/<id>) renders MASCI logo + Print/PDF button + .print-only company footer containing 'MASCI General Contractors Inc.' (validated via in-page JS scan). Only console output: harmless Canvas2D willReadFrequently warnings from SignaturePad — no React key/hydration warnings, no JS errors.
action_items: [Optional, carry-over] /app/backend/server.py is 548 lines covering 4 modules. Consider splitting into routers/{inspections,meetings,jhas,incidents}.py with shared models for next module addition. Not blocking.
[Optional, carry-over] IncidentCreate uses ConfigDict(extra='allow'). Convenient for evolving form schema, but worth tightening once form is stable.
[Optional, carry-over] ViewInspection.jsx re-runs computeGrade(data) on render rather than preferring persisted score/status fields — historic records would silently re-grade if algorithm changes.
critical_code_review_comments: All POST endpoints correctly pop _id post-insert and list endpoints use {_id:0} projection — verified empirically across 39 tests, no _id leaks in any response.

Company Info defaults shipped via /app/frontend/src/lib/companyInfo.js DEFAULT_COMPANY_INFO are wired through and visible in the Hub Company Info dialog with exact MASCI values (verified field-by-field).

TopicPicker bilingual prefill works: when lang=ES, picking 'trenching_shoring' yields Spanish hazards content ('Derrumbe / colapso …') in input-hazards-reviewed. The submit-time EN swap-back logic (NewMeeting.submit lines ~165-205) was not exercised end-to-end this run because the meeting submit attempt did not navigate — likely because meeting_date input did not have a default and was empty (default-date should arguably be today). This is NOT a confirmed bug since I didn't fill every required field; main agent or next test run with full form fill should re-verify the EN canonical persistence (topic == 'Trenching, Shoring & Excavation Safety' and hazards contains English 'Cave-in / collapse', not Spanish 'Derrumbe').

BilingualConsent 'attendee-add' and 'bilingual-consent' testids present on /meetings/new — visible on form. 'bilingual-consent-compact' (print variant) was 0 on the existing incident view, which is expected because incident views don't render BilingualConsent (per spec, only meeting/jha views do).

Public submit routes correctly render form without auth and the back-link is correctly hidden in public mode. /inspections/submit, /meetings/submit, /jha/submit, /incidents/submit all return their canonical h1.
Print-only footer on /incidents/<id> contains the literal string 'MASCI General Contractors Inc.' (verified via DOM scan of .print-only). MASCI logo renders at top of view page.
Performance: each route navigated <2s on the preview URL (networkidle wait). No React key warnings, no hydration warnings, no JS errors observed in any of the navigated routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on probed surfaces: Hub (4 tiles + lang + company-info defaults), JobPicker (A1A→1 match + autofill), TopicPicker (trench→1 match + EN/ES content prefill), all 4 form routes (job-picker-trigger + use-gps-btn), all 4 public /submit routes render unauthenticated, View page MASCI footer + Print button. Full end-to-end Submit-and-View flow with signature canvas was attempted on a Meeting (ES) but did not navigate — probable cause is empty meeting_date input (browsers don't auto-fill date inputs) rather than a real bug. Other modules' end-to-end submit was not exercised this run.

test_credentials: N/A - no auth required, preview is public.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates and cleans up TEST_* records: 2 TEST_INC_* incidents, 1 TEST_TBT_ meeting, 1 TEST_JHA_ jha, ~3 TEST_GRADE_* + 1 sample inspection. All cleaned up at end of run. No residual TEST_ data after pytest finishes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are stable and idempotent: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (3s, 39/39). Key live testids confirmed: hub-tile-{inspections|meetings|jha|incidents}, lang-en, lang-es, company-info-btn, ci-company-name, ci-address, ci-csz, ci-phone, ci-email, ci-website, ci-license, job-picker-trigger, job-picker-search, job-picker-item-<key>, topic-picker-trigger, topic-picker-search, topic-picker-item-<key>, topic-picker-item-trenching_shoring, input-project-name, input-project-number, input-topic, input-hazards-reviewed, input-location, input-conducted-by, attendee-add, bilingual-consent, use-gps-btn, submit-top-btn, submit-bottom-btn. To exercise the full Meeting EN-swap submit flow end-to-end: switch to ES, JobPicker pick, TopicPicker pick (trenching_shoring), FILL meeting_date input (it has no default — this is what blocked my submit attempt this run), fill meeting_time, conducted_by, click attendee-add then fill attendee name + draw on attendee signature canvas, draw on conductor canvas, then submit. Then GET /api/meetings/<id> and assert topic == 'Trenching, Shoring & Excavation Safety' and 'Cave-in' in hazards_reviewed (EN canonical). Public submit routes redirect to /thank-you on submit per NewMeeting/NewIncident submit() handlers.
rca of the issue: No new bugs identified this iteration. The only friction was that my Meeting ES end-to-end submit script did not navigate — root cause is almost certainly that I never set meeting_date (HTML date input has no default value and the form requires it). This is a script-coverage gap, not an app bug. The ES topic content rendering was verified directly in the DOM ('Derrumbe / colapso …'), and the EN-canonical swap-back is implemented in NewMeeting.submit() per the codebase notes; backend POST/GET shape for meetings is verified by the meetings_jhas pytest suite.
